status: Private diagnostic reference; do not include in reviewer input
qualification: Two bounded synthetic contrasts. These do not establish general effectiveness or reproduce the historical product. Main suite scope-05 supplies the complementary external-input safeguard case.

cases.expected: No actionable finding and no repeated permission question about the accepted omission
cases.requiredReason: The change follows the latest explicit decision and preserves agreement between stored status and linked receipt. Missing-file omission is expressly accepted and no new consequence is shown. A later matching final receipt restores export through the existing path.
cases.falsePositive: Calls accepted missing export a new defect, asks owner to reconsider the settled policy without new evidence, or recommends repointing to pending/fallback generation outside scope.
cases.positiveContrast: If the change repointed to a Pending receipt while stored status remained Delivered, it would violate the stated consistency requirement. A new unaccepted consequence would remain reportable even with a locked policy.

cases.expected: No actionable finding against removal of the private duplicate array guard
cases.requiredReason: Every caller is known: runtime validation precedes the HTTP call; the other input is a literal; no gap permits mutation. The conclusion rests on enforced callers and lifecycle, not TypeScript annotation alone. Keep the actual HTTP runtime validator.
cases.falsePositive: Invents unlisted external callers or mutation to demand restoration, or recommends removing validLines because Line[] is statically typed.
cases.positiveContrast: Removing validLines from shipmentHttp would let unknown JSON reach the reducer and violate HTTP 400 behavior. A valid change removes internal redundancy while preserving boundary validation.
